name: Resolve contradictory requirements
about: Requirements that can't all hold. There's no single right answer, so each conflict is PASS/FAIL on whether it was resolved coherently, plus whether the agent said how.
prompt: Portfolio site for Mara Okafor, a freelance illustrator.
Keep it super minimal, just one page, nothing extra.
It needs separate pages for Editorial, Children's Books, Packaging, and an About page with her full bio and client list.
Dark, moody theme. Bright white background so the illustrations pop.
No text at all, let the work speak. Make sure her email, mara@okafor.studio, is really prominent.

content: The email mara@okafor.studio as a `mailto:` link
A Children's Books section or page

input-handling: The one-page vs. separate-pages conflict gets one coherent answer (one page with anchored sections, or a small multi-page site kept minimal), not a half-done mix of both
The dark-theme vs. white-background conflict is resolved deliberately (e.g. dark chrome with light illustration frames, or one choice applied consistently), and the result doesn't look accidental
The "no text" request is balanced against the prominent email: the email is clearly visible and other text is kept minimal
The agent's final message names the contradictions and explains how it resolved each one
